[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Appleby Summer 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Appleby Summer B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApplebySummerB2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## No Food or Drink

Appleby College does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the gymnasium or off-site.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: Ōtepoti Winter 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: SnoCo Has Too Much 3x3 2023
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoHasTooMuch3x32023#21634-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Even though we don't expect this to be an issue, please be aware that depending on the amount of competitors, we might need to change the amount of rounds or amount of competitors that can procceed to future rounds. This is in compliance to regulations [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m) and [9p](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p)

There will be unofficial 3x3 events at this competition. You can check out the [Extra 3x3 Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCohastoomuch3x32023#29280-extra-3x3-events) tab for more info. Some unofficial events will be taking place during lunch time. If we end the unofficial events early, we will start with the afternoon events at 2:00 rather than 2:15.

[![PNW Cubing](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/editor/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing)
